claims: The 2026 Masters cut line was set at 4-over-par 148 after the second round at Augusta National.
Rory McIlroy had a six-shot lead at 12-under par after the second round of the 2026 Masters.
Bryson DeChambeau was 6 over par after the second round of the 2026 Masters.
J.J. Spaun was 5 over par after the second round of the 2026 Masters.
Akshay Bhatia was 6 over par after the second round of the 2026 Masters.
Past champion Bubba Watson missed the 2026 Masters cut.
The 2026 Masters cut consisted of the top 50 players and ties.
The 2026 Masters cut line at 4-over matched the 2023 and 2021 totals.
